d: My client, a global technology business is looking to appoint an experienced Senior Legal Counsel in a commercial legal role in Dubai.

This is an opportunity to work at the heart of a sophisticated, fast-moving commercial environment, advising on strategically important customer relationships and negotiating complex technology agreements with major enterprise clients across MEA.

You will have significant ownership of high-value negotiations, direct engagement with customers and senior stakeholders, and the autonomy to shape legal advice that supports commercial objectives while protecting the business.

The role would suit a commercially minded lawyer who enjoys the challenge of complex negotiations, is confident operating in an international environment and can bring both technical legal expertise and sound business judgement to the table.
You will take the lead on a broad range of complex technology and commercial agreements, working closely with senior commercial teams and specialist colleagues across the business.

Your work will go beyond drafting and reviewing contracts. You will be a trusted adviser in strategic customer discussions, helping the business navigate risk, find practical solutions and move important deals forward.
q: You will be an experienced commercial or technology lawyer who is comfortable handling sophisticated agreements and engaging confidently with senior business stakeholders.
r: Advising on strategically important customer relationships with large international organisations
Leading the drafting and negotiation of complex IT, SaaS, outsourcing and other technology-related agreements (approx. value €500+ million)
Taking ownership of negotiations involving English-law governed contracts
Identifying legal, regulatory and commercial risks, translating them into clear, balanced and actionable advice.
Working in close partnership with Senior Leadership, Sales, Commercial, Finance and specialist legal teams to support business priorities.
Advising on contractual interpretation, existing agreements, contentious issues and potential disputes.
Managing multiple stakeholders and driving demanding negotiations forward with confidence and independence.
Contributing to the development of contracting standards, templates, policies and best practices.
At least 6+ years' post-qualification experience (ideally more)
Substantial experience negotiating complex technology agreements, particularly across IT, SaaS and outsourcing.
A strong track record of drafting and negotiating contracts governed by Common law.
Previous experience in private practice, ideally with a focus on technology, commercial contracts or IT transactions.
Excellent commercial judgement and the ability to navigate complex customer negotiations.
Confidence advising senior stakeholders and working across international, cross-functional teams.

Above all, you will be proactive, self-sufficient and comfortable taking ownership. You will know when to take a firm position, when to find a compromise and how to make legal advice work in a commercial context.
This is a chance to join a genuinely international technology business with a substantial global presence and an important role in a dynamic, constantly evolving industry.
An established, secure employer with a fantastic culture where you can truly grow
International exposure alongside colleagues and stakeholders across multiple countries and markets, gaining exposure to complex international transactions and business priorities.
Ownership of strategically important negotiations, with direct exposure to customers and senior decision-makers.
A highly supportive and collaborative environment.
Professional development both through formal programmes and the experience of working on challenging, high-profile matters.
A comprehensive remuneration and benefits package.
A diverse global culture of a truly global business.
This is an excellent opportunity for a senior lawyer who wants to combine sophisticated technology transactions, international exposure and meaningful commercial influence.

d: We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and manage large-scale cybersecurity projects from initiation through completion and handover. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing project delivery, ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and contractual requirements.

The role requires strong experience in managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects, with the ability to coordinate cybersecurity and ICT deployments alongside construction activities, site readiness, civil works, MEP, and infrastructure development.

The candidate will act as the primary point of coordination between the customer, technical teams, vendors, subcontractors, and project stakeholders to ensure successful project execution and delivery.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years of overall project management experience, preferably in large-scale ICT, cybersecurity, or infrastructure projects.
Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects from initiation to completion.
Demonstrated experience coordinating with construction, civil works, MEP, and site infrastructure teams.
Good understanding of cybersecurity technologies and enterprise ICT infrastructure.
Experience managing project budgets, schedules, resources, risks, and contractual deliverables.
Strong experience in vendor, subcontractor, and customer management.
PMP or equivalent project management certification.
Experience in cybersecurity or ICT infrastructure project delivery.
Experience in construction, mega-projects, smart cities, or large-scale infrastructure developments.
Familiarity with project planning and reporting tools such as MS Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent.
Strong leadership and project execution capabilities.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Strong planning, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities.
Strong risk management and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to coordinate technical and construction teams effectively.
Strong reporting, presentation, and customer relationship management skills.
r: Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale cybersecurity and ICT projects.
Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, resources, and deliverables.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to agreed quality standards.
Monitor project progress and proactively address delays and delivery challenges.
Manage project scope, change requests, dependencies, risks, and issues.
Oversee the implementation and deployment of cybersecurity solutions, including:
Coordinate with technical teams to ensure completion of High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and go-live activities.
Ensure technical deliverables meet customer requirements and project specifications.
Coordinate cybersecurity and ICT project activities with construction and infrastructure workstreams.
Monitor site readiness and coordinate with civil works, Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP), ICT infrastructure, and construction teams.
Align technology deployment schedules with construction milestones and site handover plans.
Identify and resolve dependencies between construction activities and cybersecurity implementation.
Ensure sites are ready for equipment installation, integration, testing, and commissioning.
Act as the main coordination point between customers, internal departments, vendors, subcontractors, and implementation partners.
Lead project meetings, progress reviews, and stakeholder coordination sessions.
Manage vendor and subcontractor performance against project commitments.
Maintain effective communication with customer representatives and senior management.
Drive issue resolution and ensure timely escalation of critical matters.
Establish and maintain project governance, reporting structures, and control processes.
Prepare and present regular project status reports, dashboards, and executive updates.
Maintain project risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, and mitigation plans.
Manage project acceptance, documentation, handover, and final closure.
Ensure customer satisfaction and achievement of business, technical, and financial objectives.
